sentences.text: Heard on the question of admission.
Also heard on I.A.No.4922/2021, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of applicant-Ravindra.

T h e applicant has been convicted by the Courts below under Sections 7(1) read with 16(1)(A)(1) of Food Adulteration Prevention Act. and sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for 6 months with fine of Rs.2,000/-, with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that applicant was on bail during trial and the final disposal of this case would take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the substantive jail sentence of the applicant be suspended.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as the custodial sentence awarded to the applicant and without commenting on merits of the case,I.A.No.4922/2021 is allowed.

It is directed that if applicant- Ravindra deposits the fine amount, if not already deposited, and furnishes bail bond of Rs.40,000/- [Forty Thousand only] with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, the custodial sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail.
2 CRR-938-2021 The applicant shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 25.10.2021 and on all subsequent dates as may be directed in this regard.
